# Painter Hotline, Brighton CO

> House painting company serving Brighton, Colorado and the I-76 corridor: Lochbuie, Hudson, Fort Lupton, Keenesburg, Platteville, Henderson and Todd Creek. Specialists in three things the metro largely ignores out here: hail-damage repainting with written documentation before any coating, repainting new-construction homes whose builder-grade paint fails at three to five years, and coating barns, shops and metal agricultural buildings. Also interior and exterior painting, cabinets, decks and fences, and commercial work. Fully insured, free estimates, written 5-year workmanship warranty.

Phone: 720-208-5645
Service area: Brighton CO (80601, 80602, 80603) plus Lochbuie, Hudson, Fort Lupton, Keenesburg, Platteville, Henderson and Todd Creek. No travel premium on the corridor.

## Key local facts
- Adams and Weld counties sit in Colorado's hail corridor. Document damage before repainting; painting over unassessed damage weakens an insurance claim.
- Hail arrives at an angle, so north and west elevations usually take the worst. Soft materials (screens, fascia, gutters, AC fins) show damage before the siding field does.
- Production builders apply a single thin coat of low-cost paint; fading and chalking at 3-5 years is normal performance, not a defect or a warranty claim.
- Open plains mean sustained wind rather than gusts, which skins coatings early and drives agricultural dust into wet film.
- Exterior painting season: mid-May to early October, with wind often deciding a given afternoon more than temperature.
- Many corridor properties include barns, shops or metal buildings, which need rust treatment and metal-specific primers rather than house paint.
